review:
Scroll of Adventure is BGaming's tribute to the classic Egyptian treasure-hunt slot, with five paylines, a Tomb of Tutankhamun setting and symbols like tomb raiders, scarabs and goddesses. It was first released in April 2016, and BGaming's own data sheet lists a 97.1% RTP, very high volatility, a hit rate of 4.49 and a maximum win of 5,000x.

The five-line format keeps the base game sparse, and the value sits in the free spins, where BGaming lists a free spins rate of 98. If you've played any book-style slot you'll know the shape: land the right symbols, trigger the feature and hope the high-paying symbol lands often. Try the free demo to see how swingy a five-payline game can be. It suits players who want the old-school book slot feel with a higher RTP than most of the genre.
